data.content: Education is the foundation of every advanced society. So, naturally, when Universum became our client, we worked with great enthusiasm and dedication on a campaign that made a significant impact.

“Choose a degree that Counts, not just one to own” was based on the fact that Universum provides what a student really needs: the experience and diploma that open new doors and real opportunities in the job market, including the possibility to work in international companies.

The key messages of this communication focused on the value of education, the skills offered by the right university, career guidance aligned with students’ interests and market demands, as well as practical value, certification, and preparation for international markets.

This campaign exceeded our expectations, received attention exactly as intended, and many new students enrolled at Universum to gain all the benefits this university offers compared to its competitors.

Furthermore, the campaign was extended to social media and outdoor communication to raise brand awareness, highlight students’ future prospects, and increase Universum’s presence across these important channels.
